title: Dynamics 365 Finance: AI import of customer payment remittance advice for settlement
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's planned capability and roadmap targets, and searches did not identify feature-specific controls, billing or rollout details. The licensing model understates the published product-level requirements, and the description of document contents needs narrowing and supporting references.
